    .slds-modal {

                    }

            }

    .slds-modal {

            }

    }

    .slds-modal {

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {

    // Rest of your code...

    // Add scroll event listener for the scroll percentage functionality
    document.addEventListener("scroll", function() {
        let scrollContainer = document.documentElement;
        let scrollPercentage = (scrollContainer.scrollTop + scrollContainer.clientHeight) / scrollContainer.scrollHeight * 100;
        if (scrollPercentage > 40) {
            document.querySelector('.button-go-up').classList.remove('slds-hide');
        } else {
            document.querySelector('.button-go-up').classList.add('slds-hide');
        }
    });

    // Create a button to scroll to the top
    let div = document.createElement('div');
    div.classList.add('button-go-up', 'slds-hide');
    div.style = `position: fixed; width: 110px; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
                 background-image: url(/NegoptimConnect/webruntime/org-asset/d5a23528ca/resource/0814J0000019a4f);
                 bottom: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100000; background-size: contain;`;
    div.onclick = () => {
        document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
    };
    document.body.appendChild(div);
}, false);

</script>
